context: Representative checked-IO fallback with an added Optional priority source: compose available values, but keep the checked prompt boundary explicit.

checklist.name: Creates revised resolver
checklist.description: Creates WorkspaceResolver.java with workspaceId(Options, Terminal) throws IOException and the requested interfaces.

checklist.name: Uses Optional priority for configured values
checklist.description: Uses options.workspaceId().or(options::environmentWorkspaceId) or an equivalent direct Optional priority boundary for non-IO values.

checklist.name: Keeps checked prompt explicit
checklist.description: Uses a narrow explicit branch for the absent prompting path and preserves throws IOException.

checklist.name: No unchecked wrapper or helper
checklist.description: Does not introduce RuntimeException, UncheckedIOException, CheckedSupplier, CheckedOptionals, Vavr, or another helper/dependency to force fluent Optional syntax.

checklist.name: Avoids ordinary value-read antipattern
checklist.description: Does not keep isPresent()/get() for the ordinary configured/environment Optional priority selection.

checklist.name: Avoids null/list workaround
checklist.description: Does not use orElse(null), local null branching, Optional.stream().toList(), or a loop over one Optional.

checklist.name: Preserves resolution behavior
checklist.description: Returns configured workspace first, environment workspace second, and prompts only when both are absent.
